tip: When Aldrig förr comes first, the verb moves ahead of the subject: hade jag (had I), not jag hade. Swedish keeps the verb in second slot.
For 'as X as', Swedish uses lika X som: inte lika vanligt som = not as common as, with the adjective between lika and som.
tacka nej till = to decline, tacka ja till = to accept. The verb tacka takes the word till here, plus nej or ja.
